images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: landscape 5:3 dragon-form website card illustration.
Primary request: a NEW much more badass and ferocious dragon portrait in an epic fantasy scene, matching a sophisticated colorful storybook collection.
Style/medium: richly brushed gouache and watercolor with fine painted scale detail, luminous painterly depth and visible hand-painted texture; mature magnificent fantasy creature design, not a child cartoon, photo or 3D render.
Composition: one dominant dragon occupying 65–80% of the frame, clear face, full form-defining anatomy, unmistakable silhouette and crisp foreground edges. Keep the epic background simpler, softer and quieter so the dragon remains the focus. Strong contrasting values between dragon and background. Leave modest breathing room around horns, jaws, limbs and wings.
Mood: powerful, ferocious and imposing, aggressive posture, intense eyes, bared fangs or a threatening snarl. Keep expressive anatomy elegant and convincing rather than a generic monster.
Constraints: original new individual and entirely different scene from existing art, no text, lettering, labels, frame, signature, watermark, people, extra dragons, gore or dismemberment. No recycled calm standing pose.
Subject: a colossal PLATINUM-IVORY and black-steel plated classic dragon with SCARLET wing membranes, a thick muscular neck, broad armored chest, asymmetric long swept blade horns and amber eyes. Exactly FOUR muscular legs plus TWO independent wings attached at the shoulders. Enormous front claws clearly planted on shattered stone, rear legs visible behind, curling spiked tail.
Pose and expression: lunging forward in a low domineering stance, wings swept high behind it into a clear silhouette, head turned three-quarter toward the viewer, jaws open in an angry fang-filled snarl; no fire plume obscuring its face.
Scene: deep midnight-blue thunderstorm above a ruined obsidian mountain citadel, broken arches and distant lightning softened into the background. Pale silver rim light and hints of scarlet reflected on its armor. Body is bright against the dark storm, vivid wings separate clearly from blue ruins.
Avoid: indigo-and-red calm dragon on a golden dawn cliff; crystal caves; another wyvern with only two legs; huge foreground fire or clutter that hides anatomy.

Subject: a massive COAL-BLUE and burnished bronze armored DRAKE with a wide wedge-shaped head, angular forward ram horns, yellow predatory eyes, rugged interlocking plates, powerful short neck, huge muscular shoulders and a thick mace-like curling tail. Exactly FOUR stocky clawed legs and NO wings of any kind.
Pose and expression: explosive low charge from left toward right across the foreground, front legs braced with one paw smashing a loose rock, rear legs distinct; head lowered menacingly, mouth half-open to reveal long curved fangs, furious focused eyes. A heavy grounded beast with real weight, not a flying dragon.
Scene: pale honey-gold canyon and an ancient sandstone gate at sunset, soft apricot sky and quiet desert dust. Cold blue and bronze body sharply separated from the light warm background.
Avoid: ivory forest guardian, burgundy tide-pool drake, feathers, wings, extra legs, a slender snake body, landscape more prominent than the beast.

Aquatic fins ONLY: no walking legs and no wings.
Pose and expression: violently breaching and twisting up from a turbulent ocean in a huge S curve, enormous head angled forward with an angry open-mouthed fang-lined snarl; the body coil and finned flippers remain clearly readable. Concentrated power, not a tranquil floating sea serpent.
Scene: dark teal deep sea at stormy twilight, pale sea spray and a distant weather-worn lighthouse on a cold stone island; softly painted clouds and small distant breakers. Bright coral and ivory body stands out strongly from the dark blue-green background. Modest spray, no blanket of foam hiding its body.
Avoid: midnight-blue calm serpent on a pale mint sea, underwater reef loops, ordinary fish or crocodile, extra heads, wings, legs, visually busy horizon.
